acceptance: A PR into a release/X.Y.x line is opened, preflighted (receipt on the final head) and armed through repository targets with no raw gh create or merge, in a live rehearsal or the owner-accepted fixture test.
release-guide.md step 4 is correct for lines cut from tags before and after #4248, and the release skill matches.
A test covers the chosen mechanism.
description:
release/0.5.x was cut from v0.5.1, which predates #4248 (BASE=release/X.Y.x for pr-preflight, pr-open and pr-arm); v0.5.2rc3 has neither PR_OPEN_BASE nor scripts/pr_base.py. Every line PR in the rehearsal (#4249, #4250, #4303, #4363) was opened with raw `gh pr create --base release/0.5.x` and merged with `gh pr merge --squash --match-head-commit`, skipping pr-open's local review and preflight receipt; on #4303 a follow-up commit had no fresh preflight. docs/internal/release-guide.md step 4 prescribes make pr-open BASE=release/X.Y.x, which such lines do not have. scripts/release_line_create.py already copies develop's reviewer files and tests into a line's first commit, and step 3 lists files the first PR brings from develop; landing tooling is in neither. Lines cut from later tags include #4248, but any later landing-tooling fix still never reaches them. The rehearsal line has since been deleted.

Decision gates (owner):
- A: add the landing tooling (make/pr-landing.mk, scripts/pr_*.py and the tests that pin them) to the files release_line_create.py copies into the first commit, or to step 3's first-PR list; verify-line's creation rules change to match.
- B: a new develop-side entry point that drives a line PR from a separate develop checkout (pr-open has no WORKTREE variable today).
- C: document the raw gh path with an equivalent required-checks list. Not recommended: local review stays unenforced.
- Live proof needs a line, and only the owner creates lines: the owner approves a rehearsal line or accepts a fixture-level test.

Guardrails: no admin merge or check bypass; line PRs keep develop's CI, hosted review and posting checks; carried tooling must not change product files or shipped package content; verify-line keeps passing.
